g.text: A hiring manager asks for staff in the app: the role,
the site, the dates and the headcount. Before anything
reaches an agency, the request climbs that manager’s
own reporting line, as many levels as the client’s
No approver on file? The MSP decides, with a reason
Placement extensions climb the same line
or the MSP, with a reason
A request climbs the reporting line before it goes anywhere.
